title: Four Friends Singing Together
description: Share a familiar song with four friends through their voices, smiles, and simple musical actions.
cardDescription: Share a familiar song with four friends through their voices, smiles, and simple musical actions.
focus: The group can listen to one another and begin together. No formal voice-range names are needed.
solvingTip: Try a number, body part, or ordinary singing action.

answerNotes.FOUR: Four counts the people rather than the notes in a chord.
answerNotes.FRIEND: Friend describes the relationship rather than a musical role.
answerNotes.TOGETHER: Together describes their shared timing rather than their pitch.
answerNotes.BREATH: Breathing supplies the air used for a sustained vocal sound.
answerNotes.SMILE: A smile is an expression rather than part of the written music.

title: Call and Response in Gospel Singing
description: Recognize a musical exchange through a leader, answering voices, and a steady accompanying pulse.
cardDescription: Recognize a musical exchange through a leader, answering voices, and a steady accompanying pulse.
subtheme: Call and Response in Gospel Singing
focus: Call and response is used in many traditions; gospel is one setting where it is often heard.
solvingTip: Separate the opening phrase from the group's answering phrase.

answerNotes.RESPONSE: A response can repeat or contrast with the opening phrase.
answerNotes.LEADER: A leader initiates the exchange rather than necessarily singing alone throughout.
answerNotes.GOSPEL: Gospel contains different styles and is not defined by one rhythm alone.
answerNotes.AMEN: Amen has religious meaning and can also be part of a musical setting.
answerNotes.CLAP: Clapping supplies percussion without requiring a separate instrument.

answerNotes.MELODY: The same melody can sound against itself when starts are staggered.

answerNotes.LIP: The lips are brought together while the voice continues sounding.

answerNotes.TUNE: A tune can be recognized even without sung words.
answerNotes.FRIEND: A friend can join the activity without needing a formal singing role.
